title: pinalia annapurnensis
intro: Pinalia annapurnensis, commonly known as the Himalayan orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, where it is valued for its health benefits, which include its ability to lower blood sugar levels and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Pinalia annapurnensis include its antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a potential treatment for various diseases. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
